howItWorks.title: A clear path from enquiry to coordination
howItWorks.subtitle: A structured, compliance-aware process — no accounts to open, no exposure before you are ready.
howItWorks.step1Body: Tell us the corridor, currencies and purpose. It takes a few minutes and commits you to nothing.
howItWorks.step2Body: We assess the request against compliance, jurisdiction and route availability.
howItWorks.step3Body: You get an indicative structure and pricing, discussed privately over your preferred channel.
howItWorks.step4Body: Once agreed, the transaction is coordinated and settled following the appropriate procedures.

aboutPage.title: Private payment solutions for complex international business
aboutPage.subtitle: Built on years of hands-on experience across cross-border payments.
aboutPage.p1: Ayne Exchange focuses on the practical realities of moving money across borders for businesses — the corridors, currencies and documentation that international trade depends on.
aboutPage.p2: Over seven years of payment-sector experience inform how we work: privately, attentively, and with a clear understanding of how complex settlements come together in practice.
aboutPage.p3: We serve businesses and traders who value discretion and a compliance-aware approach. Every engagement is reviewed before it proceeds, and sensitive information is handled with confidentiality.
aboutPage.value1Body: Discreet, personal service. Your information stays confidential.
aboutPage.value2Body: Requests are reviewed for sanctions, AML and jurisdiction before proceeding.
aboutPage.value3Body: Solutions shaped around real trade flows, not generic products.
aboutPage.note: Ayne Exchange is not a bank or a licensed financial institution. Company registration and regulatory details will be published here once finalized.
